Нет: обучение учит убирать шум на любом: No: training teaches the network to remove noise at any level, the inference schedule is a separate choice, and a few large steps are enough
Нет: достаточно одного шага, дистилляция: No: one step is enough, no distillation needed
Сеть на каждом шаге денойзинга оценивает: At every denoising step the network estimates the clean chunk, and DDIM steps without fresh noise, so large steps don't break the shape. In the lab three or four denoising steps were enough; one step without distillation gave an estimate close to the mean of the demonstrations, and Ada clipped the kettle.
Пачку лучше исполнять целиком или по одн: Is it better to execute a chunk whole or one action at a time?
Ни то ни другое: лучший результат посере: Neither: the best result is in the middle; the authors use 8 of 16
По одному: так быстрее реакция: One at a time: the reaction is faster
При исполнении по одному действию план м: With one action executed at a time, the plan switches sides; with the whole chunk executed, the robot notices scene changes late. In the lab the best result was in the middle of the curve.
Стыки пачек можно сгладить, усреднив ста: Can chunk seams be smoothed by averaging the old and the new chunk?
Нет: среднее двух стратегий бывает недоп: No: the mean of two strategies can be an invalid action
Да, если пачки длинные: Yes, if the chunks are long
Если старая пачка объезжает чайник слева: If the old chunk goes around the kettle on the left and the new one on the right, their mean leads into the kettle. That's why Real-Time Chunking builds the new chunk onto the one already being executed instead of averaging with it.
Пачку действий лучше выдавать как скорос: Is it better to output an action chunk as velocities rather than positions?
Да: скорости не зависят от того, где роб: Yes: velocities don't depend on where the robot is now
Нет: при скоростях промахи исполнения ск: No: with velocities execution misses add up, and a late command is executed somewhere other than where it was computed; a position is a target the controller reaches on its own
Разницы нет: это одна и та же пачка в др: No difference: it's the same chunk written differently
Пачка одна, но исполняется по-разному. В: The chunk is the same, but it's executed differently. In the interactive, with a latency of 3 control steps and 1 cm of noise, the position controller kept the error at the level of a single miss, while the velocity controller drifted from the chunk several times more. The Diffusion Policy authors output positions.
Почему регрессия с пачками проигрывает д: Why does regression with chunks lose to diffusion when operators go around the kettle on different sides?
У регрессии меньше параметров, и ей не х: Regression has fewer parameters and lacks expressiveness
Регрессия со средним квадратом ошибки вы: Regression with mean squared error outputs the mean of the demonstrations, a path between the detours, while diffusion samples one of them
Регрессия не умеет выдавать пачки, тольк: Regression can't output chunks, only a single action
В лаборатории при 50 на 50 регрессия зад: In the lab, at 50/50 regression clipped the kettle, and with a strong skew it got through: the mean moves away from the kettle only when almost all detours are on one side. Diffusion has no trouble with a distribution of any shape, and when the data has a single strategy, regression with chunks is no worse and cheaper.
Доказано, что метод выигрывает из-за мул: Is it proven that the method wins because of multimodality in the data?
Да, это показано на всех бенчмарках: Yes, it has been shown on all benchmarks
Нет: это объяснение авторов, и у него ес: No: it's the authors' explanation, and there are counterarguments
Нет, мультимодальность здесь ни при чём: No, multimodality has nothing to do with it
На стандартных бенчмарках условных мод п: Standard benchmarks have almost no conditional modes (lesson 1.3), and a 2025 paper attributes the gain of generative policies to noise in training and iterative generation steps. When demonstrations from different operators really do diverge, a generative head is needed.
